## BaseX macOS Build

This is an unofficial macOS packaging release for BaseX.

- Upstream BaseX version: `__BASEX_VERSION__`
- Package type: self-contained `BaseX.app` and `.dmg`
- Runtime: bundled JDK 17+

## Notes

- This release is not affiliated with the official BaseX project.
- Artifacts are currently unsigned and not notarized.
- macOS may show a Gatekeeper warning on first launch.

## Upstream

- BaseX website: https://basex.org/
- BaseX downloads: https://files.basex.org/releases/
